title: Dubai private villas and townhouses

authorities.document: Dubai Building Code 2021, Part K Villas
UAE Fire & Life Safety Code of Practice (CDGH-OP-25)
ASHRAE 62.2 Ventilation and IAQ in Residential Buildings

assumptions: Gas: all-electric unless the plan declares gas (LPG rules then apply).
Plot: when the plan has no plot or setbacks, DBC Table K.1 defaults apply (villa 3 m road / neighbour / sikka; townhouse 3 / 0 / 3 m).
Door widths in the plan are clear widths.
Room sizes are measured clear, inside wall faces.

generator._note: Layout defaults used when the engine generates devices. Code limits come from the rules; these counts and positions are conventions, not requirements. Change them freely.

reviewer._note: Checklist for the reviewer agent (layer C). Rules with measure "reviewer" are added automatically from the rule files.

checklist.ask: Where two systems meet, does each end exist and line up? AC / AHU condensate has a floor drain to discharge to; the water heater is close to the wet rooms it serves; the DB is reachable from the kitchen and laundry circuits; every outdoor AC unit has its isolator; exhaust fans and the hood have an outside wall or shaft to discharge to.

Is anything the code requires missing even though nothing asked for it: detectors in every bedroom, living room and corridor, Hassantuk link, outdoor AV device, water tank in a conditioned space, fresh air, exhaust in every bathroom and kitchen, kitchen extinguisher, floor drains in every wet room?
Does any value look like another country default rather than a Dubai value (see foreign_values)? Flag it with the Dubai value that applies.
Every number you cite must come from the bundle (rules or plan data), never from memory. If a value you need is not in the bundle, say it is not checked.
Decide the items the engine could not: remoteness of two exits, panel near the front door, escape only through the garage, screening of outdoor equipment, and the reviewer rules listed in the bundle.

Read the whole plan once more as a single building. Is there a room nobody can reach, a door that opens onto a fixture, a wet room over or next to the majlis, a service run that crosses the whole house?
